literal_meaning: দব-দব শব্দের অনুকরণ (আলোর দপদপানোর মতো শব্দ)
figurative_meaning_en: Similar to flickering or burning brightly
example_sentences_in_english: The candle flame was burning with a flickering glow.
note: This is an onomatopoeic expression mimicking the sound or visual of flickering light, akin to 'dapdap' but less commonly used.
